topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by framing the historical concept of cancer hallmarks and outlining the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Growth Signal Autonomy and Evasion of Growth Suppression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic mutations dysregulate cell surface receptor signaling pathways to sustain proliferation and bypass growth inhibition.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells disrupt normal tissue maturation by blocking terminal differentiation across hematopoietic and epithelial lineages.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the molecular mechanisms and regulatory proteins that allow cancer cells to resist programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how telomere dynamics, telomerase reactivation, and p53-mediated stress pathways govern cellular senescence and replicative immortality.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the reprogramming of cancer cell metabolism toward aerobic glycolysis and the reciprocal effects of oncometabolites on the epigenome.

topics.label: Tumour Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the angiogenic switch that enables tumors to induce new blood vessel formation for nutrient and oxygen delivery.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Clonal Biology of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the multi-step process of metastatic dissemination, the determinants of successful colonization, and the clonal genetics of secondary tumors.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Final Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing observations on cancer hallmarks, recommended reading, and practical session housekeeping.
